title: Ahmedabad Aadhaar Fraud Racket Reportedly Used Purportedly AI-Generated Deepfakes to Change Businessman's Linked Mobile Number

behaviors.text: Police reportedly said the accused allegedly used purportedly AI-generated deepfake videos made from Patel's photo to bypass facial authentication, access DigiLocker/e-KYC services, open bank accounts, and apply for loans.
Ahmedabad Cyber Crime police reportedly arrested four people after businessman a person alleged that his Aadhaar-linked mobile number had been changed without consent.
